reason: Not that one. Make the move I named.

stop.text: Caedan Vale keeps a promise to teach Emrys, son of his former comrade.
You are the spitting image of your father. Seeing you there, I could swear the years had turned back.
Come now, strike the knight, and let me watch how you hold that sword.
What is to be learned from striking a bundle of straw?
Your father asked me the same, boy. A wall is raised one stone at a time.

steps.callout: Blows are traded only in Combat. Declare Combat, and let us begin.

reasons.skip: We came here to train, boy.

steps.callout: Your Power lets you draw a card when you declare Combat. Draw it.

reasons.pick_option: Draw it. You'll often want every card available when entering combat.

bark.text: When you declare, the knight draws three cards to answer with.

steps.callout: Rising Cut is a Strike card, and Strikes hit your opponent's Energy first. The number shown is the Energy this blow will take. Attack with it.

reasons.attack: Start with the Rising Cut, and let the others wait.
reasons.final_strike: You listen about as well as your father did.
reasons.pass: Don't pass with a free swing in front of you. Attack with Rising Cut.

bark.text: Straw and cloth are no match for me!

stop.text: See your Fervor rise? That's the Attune on your Cut, and at five you climb an Aspect.
Climbing Aspects refills your Energy, and a full Fervor meter while in your last Aspect is one way to win the match.

steps.callout: Attack with the Overhand Cut, and watch what happens when we strike an opponent with no Energy to cushion the blow.

reasons.attack: Attack with the Overhand Cut while the knight stands open.
reasons.final_strike: Not yet. A Final Strike ends your attacks, and you still hold good cards.
reasons.pass: Keep at it, boy. The knight has no Energy left.

stop.text: Its Energy was spent, so your Overhand Cut cost its Life Deck a card for every wound. Emptying that deck is another way you can win.

steps.callout: Now let's try an Art, which is different from a Strike. By default an Art costs 2 Energy, but deals Wound damage directly to the Life Deck. Attack with it now.

reasons.final_strike: Not yet. A Final Strike would end your attacks with the Dagger still in your hand.
reasons.pass: One more before you rest. Attack with the Thrown Dagger.

bark.text: Your physical Might is linked with your Energy, so paying for the Dagger weakened your Strikes.

steps.callout: Your remaining card only defends, so we have no attacks remaining. Pass.

reasons.final_strike: Keep the Parry, you'll need it soon.

stop.text: Well struck, boy, but now it's time to test your defense.
Against this thing?
Caedan ties a rope to the Straw Knight's arm.
The opponent's power is a Strike, so keep a guard ready.

steps.callout: Your Parry stops Strikes, and a stopped attack does no damage. Defend with the Parry.

reasons.no_defense: Defend. The Parry stops this Strike.

steps.callout: Combat is an exchange, so once you've defended, the next swing is yours. Attack with the Rising Cut.

reasons.pass: Hit it back while you can.

steps.callout: Your Parries only defend, but a Final Strike discards any card for a plain Strike. Then you sit out this Combat. Make a Final Strike.

reasons.pass: Swing. A pass gives up your attack.

steps.callout: Catch your breath, boy. A turn without Combat lets you Recover a card at its end. Skip Combat.

reasons.declare: Not this turn. Skip, and you can recover a card.

steps.callout: Before a turn ends, both sides discard down to one card. Keep the Parry, since the next turn is your opponent's.

reasons.keep: Keep the Parry. You'll be the one defending next.
reasons.discard_all: Keep one. It carries over to the next turn.

stop.text: Enough straw. You wanted me.
Caedan draws his sword.

steps.callout: Recover puts your top discard under your Life Deck, one more wound you can take. Recover a card.

reasons.no_recover: Recover it. That's one card of life back.

stop.text: Finally! Don't go easy!
Guard.

bark.text: Read a rival's Power. Mine just took a Sword card from my top eight.

steps.callout: Attack with the Rising Cut.

bark.text: I stopped it, but your Attune still counted. Only Hit text needs the blow to land.

steps.callout: My Riposte stopped your Cut and lets me swing it back at you. Defend with your Parry.

reasons.no_defense: Defend. You kept the Parry for this.

steps.callout: Strike cards can't stop Emrys Risks It All, and my Riposte is one. Attack with it.

reasons.attack: Risk it. My Riposte can't stop that one.

bark.text: Every Strike that lands drains your Energy, and your Might with it.

steps.callout: Its Attune brings your Fervor to five. Attack with the Rising Cut.

stop.text: Grey metal closes over Emrys' forearms.
Master Vale... my arms?
'Tis no sword art of mine.
Is it good?!
I've no idea.
You've climbed an Aspect. Your Energy is full and your Fervor is back to zero.
Whatever it is, your Might runs higher here and your Power is new.
Again.
I can't teach magic. Show me what hits.

steps.callout: A Drill stays in play until you climb, and this one adds 2 to your Strikes. Place the Clawed Hands Drill.

reasons.place: Place the Clawed Hands Drill first.
reasons.done: Not yet. Place your Drills first.

steps.callout: This Drill is a Defense Shield, so it stops my first Strike to get through each Combat. Place the Hardscale Drill.

reasons.done: Not yet. The Hardscale Drill goes out too.

steps.callout: Declare Combat.
Your new Power searches your Life Deck each Combat. The Ironscale Hide stops any attack, so pick it.
The Lashing Tail deals wounds as well as Energy, and your Drill adds 2. Attack with it.
Your Hardscale stops my Strike, so keep the Hide in hand. Take it.

reasons.defend: Save your cards. The Drill has this one.

steps.callout: Keep your Hide for my attacks. Pass.
My Declaration is an Art, which your Drill can't stop. Save the Hide for my sword. Take it.

reasons.defend: Save the Hide for my next Strike.

steps.callout: The card that first wound flipped has Endurance 3. It soaks 3 more wounds, then leaves the game. Use Endurance.

reasons.no_endure: Use it. You lose one card instead of four.

bark.text: My shout carried Disrupt 2. It knocks your Fervor down and slows your climb.

steps.callout: Pass again. My sword is still to come.
Your Hardscale has done its work this Combat. Defend with the Ironscale Hide.

reasons.no_defense: Defend. You saved the Hide for this.

steps.callout: Pass.

stop.text: Your metal's good.
Say that AGAIN!
Once is enough. Now both.

steps.callout: Declare Combat.
Pick the Twin Claws.

reasons.pick_none: Pick the Twin Claws. They swing twice.

steps.callout: Strip my Energy first, and your later blows will wound. Attack with the Clawed Heel.
The Heel lets you pay a wound of your own for 3 more wounds on me. Take a wound.

reasons.pay_life: Take the wound. It deals 3 more.

steps.callout: Now show me the sword. Attack with the Sword Flourish.

says.text: Your Flourish is Focused, so Defense Shields and cards that stop any attack miss it.

steps.callout: It landed, so its Hit brings your Swordplay Drill into play. Pick the Swordplay Drill.

reasons.pick_none: Put it into play. It adds 2 to your Sword cards.

steps.library: The Flourish fetches only the Swordplay Drill.

steps.callout: Remain 1 lets the Twin Claws attack once more this Combat. Attack with the Twin Claws.
Remain kept them on the table. Attack with the Twin Claws again.

reasons.attack: Attack with the Twin Claws again.

steps.callout: The Claws are spent. Pass.

reasons.attack: Pass now. The Claws are spent.

steps.callout: Declare Combat.
Pick the Routing Roar.

reasons.pick_none: Pick the Routing Roar. It ends this.

steps.callout: Empower adds 3 wounds but drops the text, which only hits Allies, and I have none. Attack with the Routing Roar, Empowered.

reasons.attack: Empower it. Its text hits Allies, and I have none.

steps.callout: Five or more wounds in one attack make a critical hit. Choose Disrupt 1 to slow my climb.

reasons.no_critical: Don't waste it. Disrupt 1 slows my climb.

stop.text: First Plate is your last Aspect here, so the next time your Fervor fills, you win the duel.
Enough. Show your father those arms.
Same time tomorrow, Master Vale?
...Same time tomorrow.
